Lemma
[Flat-boundary interpolation inequality] 1. ch6:6.34\group gt-ch06 If $\Omega \subset \mathbb R^n_+$ has flat boundary portion $T$ and $u\in C^{k,\alpha }(\Omega \cup T)$, then \begin{equation} \tag {6.89} [u]^*_{j,\beta ;\Omega \cup T} \leq C|u|_{0;\Omega }+\varepsilon [u]^*_{k,\alpha ;\Omega \cup T}, \end{equation} and the corresponding norm inequality holds.
Proof

\sketch The first new case is

\begin{equation} \tag {6.90} [u]^*_2\leq C(\varepsilon )|u|_0+\varepsilon [u]^*_{2,\alpha }, \qquad \alpha >0. \end{equation}

Repeat the proof of Lemma 6.32 in balls meeting $T$, using truncated balls and the mean-value theorem along tangential segments.

□
